title: Frequency Structure of AMM Liquidity Pools: A Multiresolution Analysis of Regime Transitions
summary: This study examines the temporal structure of liquidity pools in constant-product automated market makers. Using a sample of eighteen pools observed at a five-minute frequency over two years, it aims to identify the temporal scales at which interactions within the system occur and how these interactions reorganize in response to changes in the volatility regime. Methodologically, the study proposes a strictly causal Haar multiresolution analysis in which each variable is estimated using only the information available at the time of measurement.
